sourceDesign.provenanceNote: Twelve D1 frames (privacy policy, league index, profile edit and the rating journey expanded, empty and error states; light and dark) designed after D1 left these surfaces blocked and approved by the issue owner, exported read-only at scale 1 and committed unchanged. The sourceDesign digest tracks the pen as it was at export; a later pen edit by another unit does not invalidate the pinned PNGs, which are pinned by their own digests.

stateMapping.QqUGZ / pHgfV: privacy policy light / dark (real policy copy, public locale and theme chips)
stateMapping.Fj5bc / ssomJ: league index with an Active and a Closed league, light / dark
stateMapping.lNj83 / PYxIz: rating journey expanded: real history of a player with confirmed games
stateMapping.DtbIE / tgXcg: rating journey empty: a player with no confirmed game (progress state empty)
stateMapping.JYWDi / d9rkmE: rating journey error: the rating reads fail (client navigation with the rating server functions aborted)

frameOnlyElements.participation: Fj5bc / ssomJ draw a per-league participation row (Playing, Not participating, Participated, Didn’t participate). The league list payload carries no participation data, so the row is not drawn (D6: no invented data).
frameOnlyElements.seasonDates: The frames draw 1 Oct – 20 Dec 2026; the app keeps the shared league period copy (start → end) used by the league detail page.
frameOnlyElements.secondCards: The frames show two cards per section; the app shows the real leagues of the community.
frameOnlyElements.barSampleData: The frame bars and axis (3.25 to 4.00, Aug to Latest) are sample data; the app derives its bars from the real per-game history (month-end levels plus the latest level).
frameOnlyElements.recentRows: Recent games rows add outcome, signed change, reliability change and the Explain action below the frame row; the first row line (date · group, level change) matches the frame.
frameOnlyElements.statusBar: The 44px device status bar of the app frames is chrome the app never renders (frame y = live y + 44).

appOnlyElements.editExtraFields: Preferred side, dominant hand and bio are not drawn but are part of the saved profile; they follow the Preferences group so every drawn region keeps the frame order.
appOnlyElements.dataTable: The Show data table disclosure and the screen-reader summary are the chart accessibility alternatives and have no frame.

visualBudgets.measurementMethod: Full-page (or viewport, for the sticky action bar) capture at 390 CSS px, deviceScaleFactor 1, clipped per region and compared with the same CSS-px region of the scale-1 Pencil PNG with a pinned perceptual threshold (YIQ 35215 x 0.1^2). Each region is aligned on its own DOM anchor; app frames carry a 44px status bar the app never renders (frame y = live y + 44, privacy has none). Exact structural probes (sizes, radii, type, gutters, 44px targets, centered titles, sticky bar insets, no overflow at 320 and 1280) assert independently and are never relaxed by these budgets.
visualBudgets.budgetRule: budget = measured residual rounded up to 0.01, plus 0.02 for cross-renderer variance; every budget is nonzero and above its measurement.

reasons.QqUGZ:about / pHgfV:about: Long legal copy: Chromium and Pencil wrap and rasterize Figtree text differently line by line.
reasons.Fj5bc / ssomJ section and card: Small text regions (22px section title, card name, chip, dates); the shared league period copy (start → end) differs from the frame date range and the participation row is not drawn (no data).
reasons.VpcMM / xlgw8 availability and avatar: Chip labels at 13px and the initials disc: sub-pixel text positions and the focus-free rendering of the selected chips; the frame shows sample selections.
reasons.lNj83 / PYxIz chart: The frame bars, axis (3.25 to 4.00) and dates are sample data; the app draws the real month-end levels of the test player, so bar heights and labels differ by design. Structure (144px plot, card geometry, 40/800 level, bar colors) is asserted exactly.
reasons.lNj83 / PYxIz recent and row: Row text differs from the sample (real dates and groups) and a meta line follows the frame row.
reasons.DtbIE / tgXcg card and JYWDi / d9rkmE ba: Text rasterization of the 16px body and the 15px red message; geometry is exact.

QqUGZ.note: Live /privacy page height (390px, light). The approved frame is 7232px; the page keeps the frame structure (head, about section, ordered sections) and grew vertically with the PAF-199 privacy request, account deletion and residual processing sections.

pHgfV.note: Live /privacy page height (390px, dark): same page, same growth.
